profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Telegraph
profile.geoLocationName: West Des Moines, Iowa, United States

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical lead and primary developer of real-time communications platform to provide notifications, interactions, and customer engagement through Slack and Microsoft Teams, including an integrated message scheduler and API tie ins for platform-wide message bus system.
- Participated in completely greenfield rewrite of company’s legacy platform from Flask to Django framework in the midst of a hard pivot due to changing business concerns and objectives.
- Provided mentoring and training to junior developers through pair programming and code reviews.
- Participated in API design discussions and facilitated architecting choices through research and spike projects.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Technical lead and primary developer of platform to schedule, provide identity verification, and host remote online notarization sessions. The platform was used to schedule and host the first remote online notarization in the state of Iowa.
- Developed web-based applications to guide credit union employees through the mortgage origination process, including integrations with third-party vendors.
- Redesigned and updated frontend to dynamic and mobile-responsive React from static HTML.
- Provided hands-on mentoring and training for junior developers.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
- In an agile, fully test-driven development environment, created modern full-stack web applications to meet end-to-end business operation needs of over 400 client companies.
- Primary developer and maintainer of authentication and authorization system that allows management of users and permissions. System is customizable on a per-client basis and utilizes a dynamic ember.js frontend and a Django API.
- Created a process for clients to retrieve and locally back up web-systems data using Amazon SQS and S3.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
-Developed web-based chat application to allow customers to communicate with the help desk
-Maintained and developed existing reports using SQL and Microsoft Report Builder
-Compiled and organized IT documentation and created online training resources for multiple locations
-Configured ServiceNow to meet client needs
-Applied SEO principles to company website

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
-Configured ServiceNow to meet client needs
-Edited existing reports using SQL and Microsoft Report Builder
-Compiled and organized IT documentation for multiple locations
-Created reports for network consulting projects

positions.title: Robotics Camp Assistant
positions.description:
-Helped middle schoolers build and program Lego Mindstorms robots
-Taught programming basics and logic

positions.title: Math and Science Tutor
positions.description:
-Analyzed data from workshops and pilot programs
-Maintainined staff and student records
-Compiled resources to train future science tutors
-Helped students understand math and science concepts

positions.title: Robotics Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Programmed autonomous robot to aid in everyday tasks in the department
-Programmed automatic irrigation system using Arduino microcontroller
-Developed new run code for sumo robotics class
-Designed and created a robotic prosthetic hand that functioned based on muscle movements from the user
-Operated deposition chamber, ion pump, and multimeter to grow metallic films and study their electrical properties

positions.title: Team Leader
positions.description:
-Supervised groups of 8 to 15 10- to 12-year-olds
-Led small-group discussions
-Planned daily schedules for groups of children

projects.title: Point of Sale System
projects.description: This project, completed for a Software Engineering course, required a team of five students to design and program a point of sale system. With another team acting as our "customer", we had to tailor our final project to fit the needs of their store. The final submission allowed users to access different areas of the system dependent upon their permission levels. The different areas were a sales center, return center, inventory center, user administration center, and reports center.

projects.title: Limited Edition Tournaments Webpage
projects.description: This project, completed for a User Interface Design and Implementation class, involved creating a web interface for Magic: The Gathering tournaments at a local comic book store. My team designed an interface that allowed users to view and sign up for upcoming tournaments and to organize card decks for tournaments.
